fields.title: 📖 No resistance of the heart against the judgment
fields.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“They do not believe until they make the Messenger ﷺ judge in all disputes and find in themselves no distress against his judgment.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Ahlus-Sunnah joins outward Muḥākamah with inward Taslīm: no resistance to the Ḥukm of the Messenger ﷺ.

immutable.source: 📝 aṭ-Ṭabarī und Ibn Kathīr, Tafsīr zu Sūrah an-Nisāʾ 4:65.
